newsitem.title: PERU: BellSouth buys 58.69 percent of Peru's Tele 2000.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth buys 58.69 percent of Peru's Tele 2000.

text.p: Regional telephone company firm BellSouth Corp. has bought 58.69 percent of Peru's Tele 2000 for $112.2 million, Peruvian stock exchange official Francisco Palacio said Friday.
"At the close of the offering, BellSouth has managed to buy 58.69 percent, or 74,819,018 shares, in Tele 2000," Palacio said.
He said the purchase price of $112.2 million would be paid within 48 hours. He gave no other details.
The price was confirmed by a BellSouth spokesman in Atlanta, where the company is headquartered.
